constraints.label: Minimum developer equity multiple

constraints.label: Maximum residual funding gap

constraints.label: Complete modeled and executed scope

negotiation_explanations.title_en: Why the minimum is set here
negotiation_explanations.title_ar: لماذا يبدأ الحد الأدنى من هنا
negotiation_explanations.detail_en: 9.6% is the lowest tested share of eligible gross cash collections that passes both tests: calculated public NPV is USD 60,597,153.27, at least the required USD 60,000,000, and no mandatory feasibility constraint fails. A lower value is not reported as defensible because it would fall below the policy/search floor or the required public-value test.
negotiation_explanations.detail_ar: نسبة 9.6% هي أدنى نسبة من إجمالي التحصيلات البيعية المؤهلة اختبرها المحرك ونجحت في الشرطين معاً: صافي القيمة الحالية لمقابل مالك الأرض يساوي USD 60,597,153.27 وهو لا يقل عن المطلوب USD 60,000,000، ولا يفشل أي قيد جدوى إلزامي. ولا تُعرض قيمة أدنى كحد قابل للدفاع لأنها ستقع دون حد السياسة/البحث أو دون اختبار قيمة مالك الأرض المطلوب.

negotiation_explanations.title_en: Why this is the balanced recommendation
negotiation_explanations.detail_en: The core target-return point fell outside the permitted policy-adjusted interval, so 12% is calculated transparently as 9.6% + (13.8% − 9.6%) × 56%. The 56% position is the explicit balanced-position factor stored in the selected policy. At the selected point developer IRR is 134.12%, funding gap is USD 0, and public NPV is USD 75,444,805.22.
negotiation_explanations.detail_ar: وقعت نقطة عائد المطور الأساسية خارج المجال المتحفظ وفق السياسة، لذلك حُسبت 12% بشفافية وفق المعادلة 9.6% + (13.8% − 9.6%) × 56%. وتمثل نسبة 56% موضع التوصية المتوازنة المحدد صراحة في السياسة المختارة. وعند النقطة المختارة يبلغ عائد المطور 134.12%، وفجوة التمويل USD 0، وصافي القيمة الحالية لمقابل مالك الأرض USD 75,444,805.22.

negotiation_explanations.detail_en: 19.9% is the highest feasible value found by the engine before Minimum profit on cost becomes the first failing constraint. It is an economic capacity limit, not a recommended negotiating target. At the boundary, Minimum profit on cost records actual 0.2 >= threshold 0.2.
negotiation_explanations.detail_ar: 19.9% هو أعلى مستوى قابل للتنفيذ وجده المحرك قبل أن يصبح قيد الحد الأدنى للربح على الكلفة أول قيد فاشل. وهذا سقف للقدرة الاقتصادية وليس هدفاً تفاوضياً موصى به. وعند الحد يسجل قيد الحد الأدنى للربح على الكلفة قيمة فعلية 0.2 >= مقابل حد 0.2.

governing_constraint.reason_en: The nominal development margin must remain above the approved policy threshold.
governing_constraint.reason_ar: هذا القيد هو أول قيد متوقع أن يفشل عند تجاوز السقف الفني.

negotiation_explanations.detail_en: The offer of 18% is above the policy-adjusted ceiling of 13.8%; this is more favorable to the landowner. constraints.label: Non-negative whole-project profit
constraints.reason: The whole project must not consume more economic resources than its net collections.

constraints.label: Non-negative developer profit
constraints.reason: The developer must retain a non-negative nominal economic surplus before financing.

constraints.label: Minimum developer equity IRR
constraints.reason: The levered developer equity return must remain investable after landowner consideration, finance cost and repayment.

constraints.label: Minimum developer equity NPV
constraints.reason: The landowner structure must not destroy developer economic value at the approved discount rate.

constraints.label: Minimum developer profit on cost
constraints.reason: The nominal development margin must remain above the approved policy threshold.

constraints.label: Minimum developer equity multiple
constraints.reason: Timing alone cannot compensate for an insufficient absolute return on committed equity.

constraints.label: Maximum residual funding gap
constraints.reason: All required cash deficits must be covered by recognized equity or committed financing capacity.

constraints.label: Complete modeled and executed scope
constraints.reason: No material planned cost, contractual payment or out-of-horizon scope may remain unexecuted; sub-cent Decimal residuals are ignored.

constraints.label: Mandatory payment shortfall
constraints.reason: Statutory, financing and contractual obligations cannot be silently deferred; sub-cent Decimal residuals are ignored.

constraints.label: Terminal senior-debt balance
constraints.reason: The project must fully repay every recognized debt balance before financial close; sub-cent Decimal residuals are ignored.

constraints.label: Profit-share calculation convergence
constraints.reason: Circular profit-share cash flows must converge within the approved numerical tolerance.

constraints.label: Monthly sources-and-uses cash reconciliation
constraints.reason: Every monthly ledger row must reconcile opening cash and funding sources to uses and closing cash.

recommendation_rationale: Landowner NPV is measured after landowner cost contributions.
Guaranteed value includes only fixed or minimum contractual consideration.
Auditability reflects definition clarity and expected dispute exposure.
Funding and schedule components penalize liquidity pressure and programme extension.
Developer return is tested against the institutional target, not only the minimum threshold.

negotiation_explanations.title_en: Why the minimum is set here
negotiation_explanations.title_ar: لماذا يبدأ الحد الأدنى من هنا
negotiation_explanations.detail_en: 15.1% is the lowest tested share of eligible net sales that passes both tests: calculated public NPV is USD 10,047,412.06, at least the required USD 10,000,000, and no mandatory feasibility constraint fails. A lower value is not reported as defensible because it would fall below the policy/search floor or the required public-value test.
negotiation_explanations.detail_ar: نسبة 15.1% هي أدنى نسبة من صافي المبيعات المؤهلة اختبرها المحرك ونجحت في الشرطين معاً: صافي القيمة الحالية لمقابل مالك الأرض يساوي USD 10,047,412.06 وهو لا يقل عن المطلوب USD 10,000,000، ولا يفشل أي قيد جدوى إلزامي. ولا تُعرض قيمة أدنى كحد قابل للدفاع لأنها ستقع دون حد السياسة/البحث أو دون اختبار قيمة مالك الأرض المطلوب.

negotiation_explanations.title_en: Why this is the balanced recommendation
negotiation_explanations.detail_en: The core target-return point fell outside the permitted policy-adjusted interval, so 16.2% is calculated transparently as 15.1% + (17.1% − 15.1%) × 56%. The 56% position is the explicit balanced-position factor stored in the selected policy. At the selected point developer IRR is 20.33%, funding gap is USD 0, and public NPV is USD 10,779,342.74.
negotiation_explanations.detail_ar: وقعت نقطة عائد المطور الأساسية خارج المجال المتحفظ وفق السياسة، لذلك حُسبت 16.2% بشفافية وفق المعادلة 15.1% + (17.1% − 15.1%) × 56%. وتمثل نسبة 56% موضع التوصية المتوازنة المحدد صراحة في السياسة المختارة. وعند النقطة المختارة يبلغ عائد المطور 20.33%، وفجوة التمويل USD 0، وصافي القيمة الحالية لمقابل مالك الأرض USD 10,779,342.74.

negotiation_explanations.detail_en: 35.5% is the lowest tested share of distributable project profit that passes both tests: calculated public NPV is USD 10,007,859.05, at least the required USD 10,000,000, and no mandatory feasibility constraint fails. negotiation_explanations.title_en: Why this is the balanced recommendation
